from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
import pymupdf
from pypdf import PdfReader
from tests.test_pdf_structure_pages import model,assert_page_tags
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions
import aspose.words_foss as aw
cases={}
for style in ('Normal','Heading','Quote','Code'):
 for bands in (False,True):
  for columns in (1,2):
   opts=PdfSaveOptions();opts.export_document_structure=True
   raw=LdmPdfWriter(opts).write_to_bytes(model(style,bands,columns));reader=PdfReader(BytesIO(raw))
   balanced=[];counts=[];ops=[]
   for page in reader.pages:
    depth=0;underflow=False;count=0;drawing=[]
    for operands,op in page.get_contents().operations:
     if op in (b'BMC',b'BDC'):depth+=1;count+=1
     elif op==b'EMC':depth-=1;underflow |= depth<0
     else:drawing.append((operands,op))
    balanced.append(depth==0 and not underflow);counts.append(count)
    ops.append(hashlib.sha256(repr(drawing).encode()).hexdigest())
   try:assert_page_tags(raw);mapping=True
   except (AssertionError,KeyError):mapping=False
   with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as doc:
    pixels=[hashlib.sha256(page.get_pixmap().samples).hexdigest() for page in doc]
    words=[page.get_text('words') for page in doc]
   cases[f'{style}-{bands}-{columns}']={'page_count':len(reader.pages),'balanced':balanced,'mapping_valid':mapping,'marked_counts':counts,'drawing_sha256':ops,'pixels_sha256':pixels,'words':words,'pdf_bytes':len(raw)}
print(json.dumps({'module':aw.__file__,'cases':cases}))

from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
import pymupdf
from pypdf import PdfReader,PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import DecodedStreamObject,NameObject
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions
font='/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'
o=PdfSaveOptions();o.text_shaping=True;o.fallback_fonts=[font]
p=ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.Run(text='س',font=ldm.Font(size=28)),ldm.Run(text='لام',font=ldm.Font(size=28,color='Color [A=255, R=255, G=0, B=0]'))])
raw=LdmPdfWriter(o).write_to_bytes(ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(body=ldm.Body(children=[p]))]))
results={}
for tagged in (False,True):
 reader=PdfReader(BytesIO(raw))
 if tagged:
  writer=PdfWriter();writer.append(reader)
  page=writer.pages[0];stream=DecodedStreamObject()
  actual='سلام'.encode('utf-16-be').hex()
  stream.set_data(f'/Span <</ActualText <feff{actual}>>> BDC\n'.encode()+page.get_contents().get_data()+b'\nEMC\n')
  page[NameObject('/Contents')]=writer._add_object(stream)
  output=BytesIO();writer.write(output);data=output.getvalue()
 else:data=raw
 path=Path(f'/tmp/docweave-actualtext-{tagged}.pdf');path.write_bytes(data)
 with pymupdf.open(stream=data,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
  pix=pdf[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2,2))
  results[str(tagged)]={'mupdf':pdf[0].get_text(),'pypdf':PdfReader(BytesIO(data)).pages[0].extract_text(),'pixels':__import__('hashlib').sha256(pix.samples).hexdigest()}
print(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False))
Path('/tmp/docweave-actualtext-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps({'results':results,'source':Path(__file__).read_text()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
import pymupdf
from pypdf import PdfReader
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer.run_renderer import RunRenderer
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions
original=RunRenderer._render_segment_row

def logical_row(self,pdf,segments,line_h,fs,*,at_x):
 positions=[];x=at_x
 for segment in segments:
  positions.append(x);x+=segment[2]
 y=pdf.get_y()
 order=sorted(range(len(segments)),key=lambda i:segments[i].fragment.link)
 for i in order:
  pdf.set_y(y)
  original(self,pdf,[segments[i]],line_h,fs,at_x=positions[i])

results={}
for modified in (False,True):
 RunRenderer._render_segment_row=logical_row if modified else original
 cases={}
 for cut in (1,2,3):
  options=PdfSaveOptions();options.text_shaping=True;options.fallback_fonts=['/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf']
  source='سلام';paragraph=ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.Run(text=source[:cut],font=ldm.Font(size=28)),ldm.Run(text=source[cut:],font=ldm.Font(size=28,color='Color [A=255, R=255, G=0, B=0]'))])
  raw=LdmPdfWriter(options).write_to_bytes(ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(body=ldm.Body(children=[paragraph]))]))
  with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
   cases[cut]={'pypdf':PdfReader(BytesIO(raw)).pages[0].extract_text(),'mupdf':pdf[0].get_text(),'pixels':hashlib.sha256(pdf[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2,2)).samples).hexdigest()}
 results[str(modified)]=cases
print(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False))
Path('/tmp/docweave-logical-order-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps({'results':results,'source':Path(__file__).read_text()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
